item.title: Montreal, Longueuil adopt more tolerant protocols for homeless encampments
item.description: Montreal will add basic services to some sites, and will relocate others if there are safety concerns.

item.title: Jean-Talon Market shop helped put Quebec on the food map
item.description: Marché des Saveurs du Québec has been a champion of "eat local" for 25 years — long before it was ever a movement.

item.title: Canada advances to gold-medal game by a skate blade in 3-2 win over Finland
item.description: On the game-winning goal scored by Nathan MacKinnon on the power play with 36 seconds to play in regulation, Finland challenged that the play was offside. The ruling on ice stood upon review.

item.title: Stanley St. entrance to Peel métro closes again, hurting local businesses
item.description: Reopening for only one week after shuttered for a year, access is now closed indefinitely for further construction.

item.title: Todd: With time running out on road to gold, Canada finds another hero
item.description: After an uphill battle against Finland, Nathan MacKinnon completes comeback with 36 seconds left to keep Olympic hockey dream alive.

item.title: Photos: Canadiens practise outdoors
item.description: It drew many students who were able to watch their hockey heroes on the Bleu Blanc Bouge Rink at Confederation Park in N.D.G.

item.title: Former street gang member's life is still in danger following 2013 murder of Mob boss's friend, police warn
item.description: "I am a good person. I have changed," Stanley Minuty tells parole board. "Nothing could bring me back to that life."

item.title: PQ MNA blasts Olympic officials for forbidding Marie-Philip Poulin from speaking French
item.description: "Ultimate insult, humiliation, there’s no other way to describe the fact that Marie-Philip Poulin was forbidden from speaking French," Pascal Bérubé said.

item.title: Fake PEZ candies tainted with deadly drug now circulating in Montreal
item.description: In 2020, a 19-year-old in the Montreal area died from an overdose after taking etizolam in tablets disguised as pink PEZ candies.

item.title: Two Canadiens players will be coming home from Olympics with a medal
item.description: Habs captain Nick Suzuki is guaranteed at least a silver medal with Team Canada, while Juraj Slafkovsky or Oliver Kapanen will win a bronze.
